ITEM 1 | Pale yellow scrambled mass with soft, moist, curd-like clumps and small fluffy folds, light golden tones with slight deeper yellow edges, no visible browning, sits on the left side of the plate covering roughly 25% of the plate area, about 9 cm wide and 3 cm tall at the mound | 110
ITEM 2 | Bright yellow cubed fruit pieces with a glossy, slightly juicy surface and fibrous texture, cut into irregular wedges and cubes about 2 to 3 cm across, lying in a cluster on the right side of the plate and covering roughly 20% of the plate area, about 1.5 cm thick | 120
